# Third-party instruments

TinySoundFont (`tsf.h`), MIT license, upstream commit
`853a0a171759f1ddba0de1442133a75912bbeffa`:
https://github.com/schellingb/TinySoundFont

GeneralUser GS 2.0.3 by S. Christian Collins is bundled unmodified in
`assets/GeneralUser-GS.sf2`, from upstream commit
`684543d5e5efaef08d02be50dcda8d552478fa60`:
https://github.com/mrbumpy409/GeneralUser-GS

Its license is in `assets/GeneralUser-GS-LICENSE.txt`. Both licenses are
installed with Sonora. The bank can be used for private and commercial music.

Rubber Band Library 3.3.0 (GPL v2+, compatible with Sonora's GPL v3),
vendored subset (`rubberband/`, `src/`, `single/`) from
https://breakfastquay.com/rubberband/ for offline take time-stretching.
Its license is in `rubberband/COPYING` and is installed with Sonora.
